items.headline: Arkansas State grinds out 23-13 win over Southern Miss
items.description: — Clune Van Andel kicked three field goals and Arkansas State wore down Southern Mississippi for a 23-13 victory on Saturday night.

items.headline: Arkansas State meets Southern Miss in Sun Belt play
items.description: Arkansas State (2-4) at Southern Miss (1-4), Oct. 17 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Southern Miss Golden Eagles vs. Troy Trojans: Full Highlights
items.description: Southern Miss Golden Eagles vs. Troy Trojans: Full Highlights

items.headline: Goose Crowder throws for 2 TDs, runs for 2 more as Troy beats Southern Miss 55-34 to open Sun Belt
items.description: — Goose Crowder threw for two touchdowns, and he added two scores on the ground to help Troy beat Southern Miss 55-34 on Tuesday night in a Sun Belt Conference opener for both teams.

items.headline: Southern Miss visits Troy in Sun Belt matchup
items.description: Southern Miss (1-3) at Troy (2-2), Oct. 6 at 8 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Maurice Turner rushes for 200 yards and 2 TDs as Tulane survives Southern Miss 24-21
items.description: — Maurice Turner rushed for 200 yards and two touchdowns, including a 74-yard go-ahead score in the fourth quarter, as Tulane rallied past Southern Miss 24-21 on Saturday.
